summary: 澳洲动物通过与环境同色、保持特定姿势和模仿其他物种来隐藏、捕食或防御。伪装的成败既取决于外表，也取决于动物怎样行动，以及观察者会如何反应。

paragraphs.brief: 火花会增加搜索时间，因此，掠食者会直接瞄准其他物种，要么因为它看不到伪装的个体，要么它只是发现一些更明显的事情要做。
sentences: Most species use camouflage to some extent.
大多数物种在某种程度上使用伪装。
If they are convincing, they survive to pass their genes on to future generations.
如果它们能说服人的话，它们就能生存下来，把基因传给后代。
After generations of natural selection, animals can develop astonishingly complex camouflage techniques, manipulating shape, colour and movement.
经过几代人的自然选择后，动物可以开发出惊人的复杂伪装技术、操纵形状、颜色和运动。
‘The principle of camouflage is to make it economically unviable for a predator to pursue a particular species of prey,’ explains Professor Mark Elgar of the University of Melbourne.
墨尔本大学的马克·埃尔加教授：“伪装的原则是让捕食者在经济上无法捕捉特定的猎物种类。”

‘Camouflage increases the search time and, as a consequence, the predator will simply target another species, either because it doesn’t see the camouflaged individual or it just finds something more obvious to do.’
火花会增加搜索时间，因此，掠食者会直接瞄准其他物种，要么因为它看不到伪装的个体，要么它只是发现一些更明显的事情要做。

paragraphs.brief: 大部分人表现得像石头一样白天不动晚上才进食
sentences: The easiest way for an animal to disguise itself is to be invisible in its surroundings.
动物伪装自己最容易的方法就是在周围隐形
To that end, stick and leaf insects have evolved complex camouflage to hide themselves from predators.
为此，树枝和叶虫已经进化了复杂的伪装，以躲避掠食者。
Many have the texture of sticks or dry leaves, while others imitate living foliage, even the veins in a leaf.
许多人有树枝或干叶的纹理，而另一些人则模仿活叶子，甚至是叶子中的静脉。
Some insects develop blemishes to match the spots caused by disease.
有些昆虫产生污点，与疾病造成的地点相匹配。
A convincing appearance only works if its owner also acts the part, so during the day the creature using this type of camouflage keeps motionless, or sways like a dead leaf in the breeze.
只有主人也这样做，才有说服力的外表发挥作用，所以在白天，使用这种伪装的动物保持无动于衷，或像风中的枯叶一样摇晃。
If disturbed, it falls to the ground and stays still.
如果受到干扰，它就掉到地上，不动。
Entomologist Paul Zborowski, who has spent decades photographing inconspicuous creatures, rates the desert insects of Central Australia as the most convincingly disguised creatures he’s seen.
科学家Paul Zborowski花了数十年时间拍摄不显眼的生物，将澳大利亚中部的沙漠昆虫评为他所看到的最令人信服的伪装生物。
‘It’s an incredibly old habitat, so the creatures have had a long time to adapt,’ Zborowski explains.
所以动物们有很长的时间来适应，"Zborowski解释说：“这是一个令人难以置信的老栖息地。”
Most of them behave like stones and don’t move all day, feeding only at night.
大部分人表现得像石头一样白天不动晚上才进食

paragraphs.brief: 一只无动于衷地坐在树桩上的臭臭青蛙嘴也表明了把有说服力的服装和行为配对的重要性。
sentences: A tawny frogmouth sitting motionless on a stump also illustrates the importance of pairing a persuasive costume with behaviour.
一只无动于衷地坐在树桩上的臭臭青蛙嘴也表明了把有说服力的服装和行为配对的重要性。
Professor Gisela Kaplan of the University of New England in Australia says the frogmouth’s skill at camouflaging is learned behaviour.
澳大利亚新英格兰大学的Gisela Kaplan教授说，青蛙嘴在照相时的技巧是学习行为。
While adopting a pose may be a reflex of the bird, and can be observed in a hatchling’s first week, the ability to choose a backdrop which matches its colouration does not develop for 4–6 months.
虽然采取姿势可能是鸟的反射，而且可以在幼鸟第一周观察到，但选择符合其颜色的背景的能力在4-6个月中并没有发展。
When the chicks land, they are usually highly conspicuous, and their parents try to signal to them to move to a safe location.
当小鸡登陆时，它们通常非常显眼，它们的父母试图向他们发出信号，让他们搬到一个安全的地方。

paragraphs.brief: 不仅尖牙从减肥中得益与乌拉西的有益关系与其他鱼，而且伪装还让猎物更接近猎物。
sentences: Fixed camouflage is only good against a relatively unchanging environment, so some animals, such as the cuttlefish, have evolved an adaptable disguise.
固定的伪装只对相对不变化的环境有利所以一些动物，如小白鲸已经进化了一种适应性强的伪装
The cuttlefish can almost instantly change its colour, pattern and texture to match its surroundings, using specialised cells and muscles.
使用专门的细胞和肌肉，切鱼几乎可以立即改变其颜色、形态和质地，使其周围环境相匹配。
On Queensland’s reefs, scientists have been studying another ocean dweller that uses colour change, although not to blend into the surroundings.
在昆士兰的珊瑚礁上，科学家们一直在研究另一个使用颜色变化的海洋居民，尽管他们不会融入周围环境。

Dr Karen Cheney, from the University of Queensland, says the bluestriped fangblenny alters its colouration to mimic other species of fish, allowing it to travel with them and benefit from safety in numbers.
昆士兰大学的Karen Cheney博士说，蓝调的尖牙改变了它的颜色模仿其他鱼类物种，允许它与它们一起旅行，并受益于数量上的安全。
Its most impressive impersonation is of the black-with-neon-blue-striped cleaner wrasse, which eats the parasites on larger fish.
它最令人印象深刻的模仿是黑和黑的蓝色的更清洁的鱼食用大鱼的寄生虫
Not only does the fangblenny benefit from the reduced predation that comes with the wrasse’s beneficial relationships with other fish, but the disguise also lets it get closer to prey.
不仅尖牙从减肥中得益与乌拉西的有益关系与其他鱼，而且伪装还让猎物更接近猎物。
It darts out from the safety of the wrasse’s cleaning station to nip at unsuspecting fish passing by, but it doesn’t attack those coming to be cleaned.
它飞镖从乌拉塞清洁站的保险箱里飞出来在鱼路过时被毫不怀疑的鱼吞噬但它不会攻击那些来清理的人

paragraphs.brief: Martyn Robinson是澳大利亚博物馆的一名教育性自然学家：“如果捕食者遇到太多可以食用的东西就会认为那些有这些标记的动物都不是危险的东西。”
sentences: The most famous form of mimicry, however, is for defence, not attack.
然而，最著名的模仿形式是防御，而不是攻击。
Batesian mimicry refers to animals that gain protection from predators by imitating a dangerous organism, often using conspicuous colours.
贝茨模仿是指动物通过模仿危险的有机体，往往使用显眼的颜色，从而获得免受掠食者伤害的保护。
The nineteenth-century naturalist Henry Bates first suggested this camouflage technique after noticing that several Amazonian butterfly species looked the same.
十九世纪的自然学家亨利·贝茨在发现一些亚马逊蝴蝶物种看起来一样后首次提出这种伪装技术
The technique was later called after him.
后来有人叫他来电
In Australian waters, the harmless harlequin snake eel sports the same black and white bandings as the highly toxic yellow-lipped sea krait, ensuring no predator will attack.
在澳大利亚水域，无害的哈林金蛇海螺运动与高毒性黄滑海虾一样，黑白带状，确保没有掠食者攻击。
However, the success of Batesian mimicry depends on the ratio of mimics to originals.
然而，贝茨仿造的成功取决于仿造与原创的比例。

If a predator encounters too many that are edible, it will just assume none of the animals with those markings are dangerous, explains Martyn Robinson, an educational naturalist with the Australian Museum.
Martyn Robinson是澳大利亚博物馆的一名教育性自然学家：“如果捕食者遇到太多可以食用的东西就会认为那些有这些标记的动物都不是危险的东西。”

paragraphs.brief: 鹰蛾毛虫的腹部有类似于蛇眼的标记。
sentences: An imitation of a more dangerous creature needn’t be exact, just enough to make potential predators hesitate.
模仿一个更危险的生物不需要精确，仅仅足以让潜在的掠食者犹豫。
The hawk moth caterpillar has markings resembling a snake’s eyes on its abdomen.
鹰蛾毛虫的腹部有类似于蛇眼的标记。
When confronted, the caterpillar pulls its head in and the ‘eyes’ flash open.
毛毛虫在面对挑战时，头部被拉开，“眼睛”一闪而过。
Whether the potential predator thinks it has seen a snake, or is simply startled, is unclear, but the outcome is that the caterpillar lives to see another day.
潜在捕食者认为它见过蛇，还是只是被吓到了，现在还不清楚，但结果却是毛虫活了一天。

paragraphs.brief: 它的身体是棕色的，但它的尾巴是黑白的。
sentences: In Queensland’s tablelands, the chameleon gecko has another way of making predators hesitate.
在昆士兰的地盘上，变色龙壁虎有另一种方法让掠食者犹豫不决。
Its body is brown, but its tail is banded in black and white.
它的身体是棕色的，但它的尾巴是黑白的。
Robinson explains that if attacked, the chameleon gecko will drop off its tail, which will wriggle around on the ground.
Robinson解释说，如果受到攻击，变色龙壁虎会掉下尾巴，在地面上摇晃。
Many lizards do this, but in the case of the chameleon gecko the tail bones actually rub against one another, so it squeaks.
许多蜥蜴都这样做，但是对于变色龙壁虎，尾巴骨实际上是相互摩擦，所以它吱吱作响。
‘The predator is, of course, thoroughly absorbed by this black-and-white-striped, wriggling, squeaking thing on the ground, and the gecko can sneak away,’ Robinson says.
鲁滨逊说地上乱叫壁虎会溜走的：“捕食者当然被这个黑白掠食者完全吸收了。”
It’s a one-time-only trick: the regrown tail is brown, the same as the gecko’s body.
这是一次性的把戏：重新生长的尾巴是棕色的，和壁虎的身体一样。
Such precise disguise and elaborate trickery illustrate the limitless possibilities of nature.
这种精确的伪装和精心策划的诡计说明了自然的无限可能性。
But, as Robinson points out, only the most successful illusionists are here to tell the tale.
但是，正如罗宾逊指出的那样，只有最成功的幻觉家才能在这里讲述故事。

items.en: a species that indicates to its young to move to a place where they are less visible
items.zh: 一种向幼虫表示迁移到不显眼的地方的物种
items.why: “indicates to its young”=“signal to…(the chicks)”。只有 C 段出现“父母示意幼患移动” 的行为。B 仅谈昆虫拟态与静止,G 谈壁虎断尾。D 谈墨鱼 / 牙铺变色，不涉及“给幼串信号”。

items.en: an instance where sound is used to help an animal escape
items.zh: 使用声音帮助动物逃跑的例子
items.why: “sound is used”e“squeaks (叶咏响)”。D段牙铺靠伪装靠近并非声音。F段天蛾幼虫靠“眼斑” 惊吓而非声音。

items.en: a creature that can use camouflage to match a range of different backgrounds
items.zh: 一种能用伪装来匹配不同背景的生物
items.why: “match a range of different backgrounds”= 能随环境变化而变 (可变色/纹/质地)。A、B、C 多为固定背景。D段点名可快速自适应。

items.en: a claim that the majority of animals disguise themselves in some way
items.zh: 声称大多数动物以某种方式伪装自己

items.en: examples of animals that use camouflage to look like plants
items.zh: 以伪装为植物的动物为例
items.why: B段举出伪装成枯枝、干叶乃至模仿活叶叶脉的动物，都是把自己伪装成植物的例子。

items.en: one species has a camouflage tactic that is not present from birth.
items.zh: 一种物种有伪装的策略天生就不存在

items.en: species that live in an ancient environment have become very effective at camouflaging themselves.
items.zh: 生活在古代环境中的物种已经变得非常有效以胶布本身。

items.en: part of an animal is left behind to distract predators.
items.zh: 动物的一部分留下来分散食肉动物的注意力

items.en: if it takes too long to find one kind of prey, animals will look for an alternative source of food.
items.zh: 如果找到一种猎物要花太多时间动物们会寻找其他的食物来源

items.en: camouflage can involve copying a threatening type of animal.
items.zh: 伪装可能涉及复制一种威胁性的动物

items.en: The bluestriped fangblenny Dr Karen Cheney studies the bluestriped fangblenny on ________ off Queensland’s coast.
items.zh: 凯伦·切尼博士在昆士兰近海的________研究蓝纹拟唇齿鳚。
items.why: 在昆士兰海岸外的 _上研究。

items.en: The fangblenny impersonates the striped cleaner wrasse, a fish that is welcomed by other species as it gets rid of their ________.
items.zh: 这种鱼模仿裂唇鱼。其他鱼类欢迎裂唇鱼，因为它会帮它们清除________。
items.why: 清洁隆头鱼被欢迎，因为它清除其他鱼身上 Ayes o。

items.en: The fangblenny can approach its ________ without drawing the attention of predators or disturbing the work of the striped cleaner wrasse.
items.zh: 蓝纹拟唇齿鳚既能接近自己的________，又不会引起捕食者注意，也不会打扰裂唇鱼的工作。
items.why: 牙铺可以接近它的 _而不引人注意。

look for an alternative source of food

points: “sound is used”e“squeaks (叶咏响)”。D段牙铺靠伪装靠近并非声音。F段天蛾幼虫靠“眼斑” 惊吓而非声音。
在昆士兰海岸外的 _上研究。

Many have the texture of sticks or dry leaves, ….
连接词 while 引出“while others imitate living foliage, even the veins in a leaf”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。

lead: Many species of animal in Australia protect themselves by using camouflage — a way of ‘hiding’ by blending into the surroundings.
澳大利亚许多动物使用伪装来保护自己 - - 这是一种"隐藏"的方式 - - 通过融入周围环境。
